response.sql: WITH per_race AS (SELECT r.raceId, r.name, AVG(cr.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(*) AS result_count FROM constructorResults AS cr JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId WHERE cr.points > 1.0 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name), race_name_avg AS (SELECT name, AVG(avg_points) AS name_avg_points FROM per_race GROUP BY name) SELECT p.raceId, p.name, p.avg_points, p.result_count, p.avg_points / NULLIF(n.name_avg_points, 0) AS ratio FROM per_race AS p JOIN race_name_avg AS n ON n.name = p.name ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC, p.raceId LIMIT 10
